primary_control.scope: selected counters exclude some UDP types; read brackets/availability/identity preserved; all qualifying adjacent source gaps retained, boundaries censored; routing mapping is not authentication; no unique cause, physical delivery, nonexecution or performance inference

analysis.scope: All primary >=1s gaps and active CONTROL loss windows; hashes/native/clock identities qualified by primary analysis. ARP tuple presence is not authenticated neighbor acceptance or request/reply nonce pairing; reflected local copies kept separate. Sampled netlink/TC read brackets are not exact transitions or flow-specific drops; root counters cannot be summed with child. Stage classification is association, not unique cause, nonexecution, latency or tuning authority.
